axes_units: Left chart: Prevalence (%) of children under 5 years affected by stunting, wasting and overweight, global, 2000–2022; Right chart: Number (millions) of children under 5 years affected by stunting, wasting and overweight, global, 2000–2022
summary: The figure shows two line charts depicting the global prevalence (%) and number (millions) of children under 5 years affected by stunting, wasting, and overweight from 2000 to 2022. Stunting prevalence and number have steadily decreased over this period, while overweight prevalence and number have slightly increased or remained stable. Wasting prevalence and number are shown only for 2022, with wasting prevalence at 6.8% and 45 million children affected.
